title: Krylov complexity of anyons
summary: Anyons obey fractional statistics that lie between bosonic and fermionic statistics, giving rise to a broad range of intriguing phenomena. However, how anyonic statistics govern quantum-state complexity is still largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the interplay between the statistical phase and on-site interactions in the anyon-Hubbard model, identifying exact quantum many-body scar eigenstates and novel quench dynamics.
